text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: high-error-rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 (p95 latency > 2s) — triggered 2123456789. Link: https://monitoring.prod/redwood/alerts/2123456789 :rotating_light:

Maria (SRE): seeing the same in tracing. errors are 503 from runtime pool.

Devin: I'm taking this — oncall now. pinging SREs. I'll start a handoff when I have a quick summary.

Jess (CS): heads-up — zonal customers might see failures. Do we have a quick customer-facing blurb for Zendesk?

Sanjay: quick root cause hypothesis: GPU node oom -> autoscaler thrash -> backend 503s. Not 100% yet.

Devin: summary for handoff:
- Impact: generation requests to models served from us-west-2 may return 5xx or timeout.
- Scope: ~30% of requests in the last 5m, starts 2123456700.
- Mitigation in progress: draining bad node group, fallback routing enabled to another pool.

Maria (SRE): steps I'm running:
1) `rk infra nodes list --region=us-west-2 --status=degraded`
2) if found, `rk infra nodes drain <id>` and `rk infra autoscale pause --cluster=rw-gen-west`
3) enable fallback: toggle `route_policy=allow-fallback=true`

Devin: doing 1/2 now. sharing logs in the bridge.

Alex: small template for status page update (short):
> Current status: Partial outage — Some users in US-West are experiencing increased errors and latency for text generation. Our engineers have identified impacted runtime nodes and are executing mitigations. We will post updates every 15 minutes.

Jess (CS): Zendesk macro draft for customer-facing replies (short, empathetic):

> Hi {{customer_first_name}},
>
> Thanks for reporting this. We're currently investigating an issue affecting text generation for some requests in US-West. You may see 5xx errors or slow responses. Our engineers are working on mitigation and we'll update you shortly. If you can share any recent request IDs, that will help us correlate logs.
>
> — Jess, Redwood Support

Sanjay: also put an internal note for high-severity customers: we should proactively email customers on reserved capacity.

Devin: quick agent checklist to paste into Zendesk private note before passing to CS: 
- Impact window and region (start ts)
- Affected models/routes
- Mitigations applied (drain/route/fallback)
- Links: monitor, trace, logs, status page
- Assigned oncall

Pasteable checklist (private note):
```
Impact start: 2123456700
Region: us-west-2
Routes: /v1/generate (all models served from rw-gen-west)
Mitigations: drained node group id=g-7f3, enabled fallback routing, paused autoscaler
Monitoring: https://monitoring.prod/redwood/alerts/2123456789
Tracing: https://tracing.prod/redwood/trace/xyz
Assigned: Devin (oncall)
```

Maria (SRE): quick troubleshooting commands for agents (internal):
- Check customer request id: `rk logs query --req-id=<id> --region=us-west-2`
- If you see `runtime_pool_oom` tag, escalate to SRE and include the node id.

Jess (CS): Intercom short reply for high-volume customers (public):
> We’re aware of an issue causing higher error rates for text generation in US-West. Engineers are applying mitigations now; we’ll follow up as soon as we have an ETA.

Alex: reminder: include the status page link in all public comms and note that we will update every 15 mins until resolved.

Devin: update — drained node group completed, fallback routing verified. Error rate dropped to ~6% from 30%. continuing to monitor.

Maria (SRE): logs show residual 500s from a cache layer. I'm going to restart the cache service on the drained nodes to reclaim resources, then we can unpause autoscaler.

Jess (CS): customer macro additions for Enterprise customers (private email):
> Hi {{account_owner}},
>
> We detected elevated errors for generation requests in US-West. We have routed traffic away from affected nodes and are restoring normal capacity. Our engineering team will follow up with a post-incident summary and any potential customer impact details. If you rely on Reserved/Dedicated capacity, we can coordinate a proactive failover.
>
> — Jess, Redwood Support (on-call)

Sanjay: aftercache restart, watch for error delta and token throughput. if error rate >10% for 10m, escalate to L2 and consider regional failover.

Devin: handoff snippet for next oncall (to paste in thread at handover):
> Handoff — 2123456789
> - Current status: recovering, error rate 6%
> - Actions taken: drained node g-7f3, enabled fallback routing, restarted cache on affected hosts
> - Next steps: monitor 15m windows, unpause autoscaler when stable
> - Contacts: Maria (SRE), Sanjay (infra), Jess (CS)

Maria (SRE): I'm adding a short postmortem placeholder in incidents tracker with tag `pg:production` and linking monitoring graphs.

Jess (CS): assigning customer tickets to `support-oncall` queue with private note (paste checklist) and public reply macro.

Devin: logging final for this thread before I sign off:
- Setting status page short update now.
- I'll leave watch for another 10m then hand over to Alex.

Alex: ack, I'll pick up the watch and post the 15-min update. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: UPDATE: Status page entry posted (ID: sp-2123456789). Next automatic update scheduled in 15m.

Jess (CS): saved macros for CS team (paste into Zendesk as templates):
-- Macro name: "GENERATION_USW_INCIDENT_BRIEF"
Content: "Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for flagging this. We're investigating elevated errors affecting generation in US-West. Engineers are applying mitigations and we've routed traffic away from impacted nodes. We'll update you ASAP. If you can share request IDs, please add them here."

-- Macro name: "GENERATION_USW_ENTERPRISE_ESCALATE"
Content: "Hi {{account_owner}}, we’re on it — affected traffic has been routed away from impacted hardware. We expect service to be restored shortly; a post-incident impact summary will be provided. If you want a direct sync, we can schedule one."

Devin: leaving a short note for post-incident action items:
- Confirm root cause (OOM nodes vs autoscaler bug)
- Investigate why fallback didn't fully absorb load earlier
- Add guardrail to pause autoscaler automatically when node oom rate > X

Maria (SRE): noted. adding to incident board.

Alex: final: passing watch to oncall rotation lead @Devin for the next 30m — please escalate if regression.

Devin: signing off from active mitigation, oncall watch handed to Alex. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
